correctness.rationale: Antiderivative tests in y and z give the two conditional laws. Their first moments imply E[x]=E[y]=-(3/10)E[z] and E[xy]=E[y^2]=E[z], producing q=(9/100)E[y^2], the exact mean segment and variance parabola. Stationarity of y^2/2 and z^2/2 expands to the two nonnegative squared-speed variance defects; zero of either speed on invariant support propagates to x=y and z=x^2, or to x=-(3/10)z with the unique bounded complete y solution y=x, hence only the two equilibria. Stationarity of yz gives E[yz]=(10E[y^2]-3E[z^2])/7, which rearranges exactly to the 7/13 gap. Equality forces y=z, then tangency gives y=z=0 and x=0. The exact verifier checks the equilibria and all algebraic coefficients.
